image_description: A teal-colored minibus (resembling a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter or similar van chassis) parked outdoors with dense green foliage in the background. The vehicle is angled slightly to the right, showing the front grille, headlights, driver's side door, and side windows. A license plate is visible on the front bumper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof van profile associated with minibuses. It is clearly shorter than a full-size transit bus but has sufficient height for passenger accommodation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible. Multiple side windows are present along the passenger cabin area on the visible side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The driver/passenger entry door is located at the front of the vehicle body, consistent with minibus design. The roofline is high relative to the wheel arches.

The front door appears to be a standard hinged door (common for the driver/entry in this class of van-minibus). While 'sliding' is common for rear passenger doors, the primary entrance shown is functional and structurally sound.
The presence of a distinct hood/bonnet section ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout, typical for this type of van-based minibus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is completely occluded by the angle of the photograph; only the front and side are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a solid teal/green paint job. While not white/yellow, it fits the 'company livery' description. No specific route markings are clearly legible, but the paint finish is consistent.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel is proportional to the vehicle body, featuring a realistic rim structure and tire contact patch.
The window configuration and overall length suggest a capacity within the 4-10 passenger range, distinguishing it from larger coaches or smaller vans.

The logo on the front grille is vaguely circular but lacks the precise geometric symmetry and detail of a real manufacturer emblem, appearing slightly melted or generic.
